_readme: Data file for ops/pain_hunter.py — edit by hand, no code changes needed. Source: .claude/docs/x-sorun-haritasi-2026-09-27.md + curated-signal-2026-09-27.json (cdpilot repo). Queries are quoted, first-person phrasings — unquoted multi-word queries were measured 30/30 noise (see harita doc 'Sorgu kalitesi'). Every cdpilot_answer command below was verified against README.md/src/cdpilot.py (see task report for file:line).

session_cookie_persistence.cdpilot_answer: cdpilot cookies save/load, cdpilot cookies auto on (per-host cache ~/.cdpilot/cookies/<host>/, auto-replay before navigate)

headless_detection_anti_bot.cdpilot_answer: cdpilot mode stealth, cdpilot adaptive on, cdpilot captcha-solve — PARTIAL: own Stealth Bench shows Cloudflare ~55% but PerimeterX 11%/GeeTest 0%/Kasada 0%, be honest about the hard tiers
headless_detection_anti_bot.missing: hard anti-bot tiers (PerimeterX/GeeTest/Kasada) remain weak in cdpilot's own bench

mcp_vision_token_cost.cdpilot_answer: cdpilot smart-click / cdpilot smart-fill (act on an element by its visible text, so that step needs no page snapshot and no vision model), cdpilot a11y-snapshot (structured text with @ref handles, no vision model — NOT a token saver: on link-heavy pages it is larger than a small screenshot, so never pitch it to someone whose snapshots are already too big)

heavy_browser_tool_setup.cdpilot_answer: npx cdpilot launch (no npm dependencies: one Python file plus a small Node launcher; Python needs the websockets module, installed on first launch)

agent_cant_use_own_session.cdpilot_answer: cdpilot cookies save --host <host> (from the user's real browser), cdpilot cookies load --host <host> (replay into cdpilot's isolated profile)

flaky_selector_wait.cdpilot_answer: cdpilot smart-click, cdpilot smart-fill (visible-text matching, auto-wait, no CSS selector), cdpilot wait-for-text

shadow_dom.cdpilot_answer: cdpilot smart-click, cdpilot smart-fill (Shadow DOM traversal shipped — Lightning/Polymer/lit-element widgets)

iframe_support.missing: iframe element interaction — README lists it under 'Coming Soon', no in-tree fix today (frame list/eval exists but not full interaction inside an iframe)

tls_fingerprint.missing: in-tree TLS fingerprint spoofing — cdpilot tls-check only probes JA3/JA4, does not patch it

query_note: Short bare word sets: X ANDs them. Measured 2026-09-27 — quoted phrases returned 0, OR-operator queries returned mostly noise. Re-measure before adding quotes or operators; the weekly digest lists queries that never produce a signal.
